description: This file is the entry point for the React-based frontend application. It imports React libraries, CSS styles, and the main App component, then renders the App within the DOM element with id 'root' using React's createRoot API.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a root for rendering React components into the DOM.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders React elements into the created root.
